note: schema_type! fixes: partial moves a wrapped field's garde rules into inner(..), so custom(..) gets the Some value and a source inner(..) still checks the elements (matches of another wrapped field and the field-level settings stay outside; skip / dive keep the rules as written); a Self in a source field type names the source struct; multipart DTOs read the source's deserialize-side rename_all, keep a field's cfg_attr serde rename / alias / default / skip and its serde alias, and carry deny_unknown_fields; a relation adapter DTO's Self:: serde paths name the DTO in its deserialize proxy; an unknown rename_all rule is a compile error. Multipart derive: serde(deny_unknown_fields) rejects unknown and nameless parts with 400, matching the closed request schema.
